_doc: Phase 3 sim config — points the racer_companion at BF SITL via TCP. WAYPOINT IS A (0,0) PLACEHOLDER: run `python -m integrations.tools.discover_bf_gps` to read what GPS coords BF SITL is actually reporting at the chemical-plant spawn, then update waypoint.lat_deg / .lon_deg below. See docs/09_sim_phase3_smoke.md. NOTE safety.min_vbat=0 is SIM-ONLY (BF SITL replies to MSP_ANALOG with vbat=0.0, so 14.4 would block forever); set back to 14.4 (or per-pack) for any real-hardware config.
